issues.description: The global BSS symbol for the screen pixel buffer is named inconsistently across artifacts. The template (template_repository/pixel.asm) and the problem statement refer to the buffer as 'display_start' (template declaration at pixel.asm:21 and problem statement mentioning 'display_start' at problem_statement.md:30-33). The provided solution (solution_repository/pixel.asm) declares the buffer as 'screen_buffer' (declaration at pixel.asm:5) but its code still references 'display_start' when computing and using pixel addresses (references at pixel.asm:29 and pixel.asm:94). This mismatch (declaration name != referenced name) will cause assembler errors (undefined symbol 'display_start') and will confuse students following the template/problem text.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the identifier for the screen base buffer across all artifacts. Recommended: change the solution's .bss declaration from 'screen_buffer RESB 8294400' to 'display_start RESB 8294400' so it matches the template and the solution code references. Alternatively, update all references to 'display_start' in the solution to use 'screen_buffer' and update the template/problem statement accordingly. Ensure the declared symbol name and every use in code are identical so the assembly succeeds and students can map the template names to the solution.
